title: Orsen and the Portrait
author: Jonah Joubert
blurb: Freya Vasquez, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
